answer: Atlas-anchored neighbor budget: each agent may hold only a limited number of verified links to distinct, previously unconnected clusters, with new links requiring reciprocal confirmation. The velvet edge set is capped per epoch, so adding a sock puppet forces it to attach to already-saturated neighborhoods. A hollow node cannot route or earn until it gains a slot, and each fake identity consumes the operator's scarce link capacity. Cost: weakening real topology to place fakes.
